rounds.text: NDR Auto Components Ltd exhibits superior capital efficiency, with an ROE of 18.9% and an ROCE of 22.2% significantly outperforming sector benchmarks of 11.88% and 12.89% respectively [E9, E10, E12, E13]. This operational excellence is supported by a robust 5-year compounded profit growth of 49% and a 5-year sales growth of 48%, demonstrating a consistent ability to scale the business [E14, E17]. The company maintains a conservative financial structure with a debt-to-equity ratio of only 0.15x and a reduction in total borrowings to Rs 58 Cr [E33, E35]. Furthermore, the current market price implies an earnings growth rate of only 11.6%, which is notably lower than the company's historical performance and the 18.0% growth assumed in base-case intrinsic value models [E43]. Conceded: the stock has experienced a 12-month price return of -22.2% and currently trades below its 200-day moving average, reflecting negative institutional money flow [E40, E48, E63]. Despite these sentiment-driven headwinds, the company is actively investing in future capacity, evidenced by a 105.3% increase in capital work in progress [E36].
